build_lstm_model: build an LSTM encoder-decoder model for sequence-to-sequence machine translation tasks
build_lstm_encoder: build an LSTM encoder with configurable hidden size, layers, and bidirectional support
build_lstm_decoder: build an LSTM decoder with attention mechanism and incremental state caching
build_attention_layer: build an attention layer that computes attention scores between decoder and encoder outputs
configure_lstm_architecture: configure LSTM model architecture with preset configs like wiseman iwslt or luong wmt
